episodes.title: Part One: Family Man
episodes.summary: Following his wife's death, sex addict and salesman Bunny Munro finds himself saddled with a young son and a loose concept of parenting.

episodes.title: Part Two: Salesman
episodes.summary: Desperate to escape his grief, Bunny fills the void by seducing his customers, as Libby's appearances comfort Junior.

episodes.title: Part Three: Cocksman
episodes.summary: Bunny and Junior's road trip hits a snag when he loses his client list after sleeping with a customer.

episodes.title: Part Four: Con Man
episodes.summary: Bunny tries to make the money he needs to get back to Junior. Meanwhile, Junior gets a sense of what a normal life looks like.

episodes.title: Part Five: Dead Man
episodes.summary: When Bunny and Junior's visit to Bunny Senior doesn't go to plan, Bunny's behaviour becomes increasingly erratic.

episodes.title: Part Six: Showman
episodes.summary: Bunny and Junior make it to the sales expo where Bunny faces down his demons, seeking forgiveness from figures from his past.
